description: TPC-H SF=10 performance baseline stored in version control. Updated monthly or after intentional performance changes. Alerts trigger on >15% regression for any query.

Q1.name: Pricing Summary Report
Q1.description: Full scan + filter + aggregation on lineitem (6M rows at SF=10)

Q2.name: Minimum Cost Supplier
Q2.description: Correlated subquery with multi-table join (part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region)

Q3.name: Shipping Priority
Q3.description: 3-table join with filter and top-N (customer, orders, lineitem)

Q4.name: Order Priority Checking
Q4.description: Semi-join with date range filter (orders, lineitem)

Q5.name: Local Supplier Volume
Q5.description: 6-table join with aggregation (region, nation, supplier, customer, orders, lineitem)

Q6.name: Forecasting Revenue Change
Q6.description: Single table scan with range predicates and aggregation (lineitem)

Q7.name: Volume Shipping
Q7.description: Multi-table join with CASE expression (supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation)

Q8.name: National Market Share
Q8.description: 8-table join with division and CASE (part, supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation, region)

Q9.name: Product Type Profit Measure
Q9.description: 6-table join with expression evaluation (part, supplier, lineitem, partsupp, orders, nation)

Q10.name: Returned Item Reporting
Q10.description: 4-table join with filter on return flag (customer, orders, lineitem, nation)

Q11.name: Important Stock Identification
Q11.description: Subquery with HAVING threshold (partsupp, supplier, nation)

Q13.name: Customer Distribution
Q13.description: Left outer join with nested aggregation (customer, orders)

Q16.name: Parts/Supplier Relationship
Q16.description: Anti-join with GROUP BY and COUNT DISTINCT (partsupp, part, supplier)

Q18.name: Large Volume Customer
Q18.description: Subquery with GROUP BY HAVING and top-N (customer, orders, lineitem)

Q19.name: Discounted Revenue
Q19.description: Complex OR predicates with join (lineitem, part)

Q20.name: Potential Part Promotion
Q20.description: Nested subqueries with semi-join (supplier, nation, partsupp, lineitem, part)

Q21.name: Suppliers Who Kept Orders Waiting
Q21.description: Multi-level EXISTS/NOT EXISTS (supplier, lineitem, orders, nation)

Q22.name: Global Sales Opportunity
Q22.description: Subquery with NOT EXISTS and AVG (customer, orders)
